en.text: A pin is a frozen copy of an approved spec that a task uses until the captain approves a change.

zh-TW.text: 固定版本是已核准規格的凍結副本，任務用它直到船長核准修改。

en.text: A repin replaces the pin of a task with a new approved version of its spec.

zh-TW.text: 重新固定是用新核准的規格版本取代任務的固定版本。

en.text: A standing item is one numbered change on the reviewer list that a task must make before the review can pass.

zh-TW.text: 待辦項目是審查清單上的一個編號修改，任務必須完成它才能通過審查。

en.text: A gate is one automatic check that a pull request must pass before a merge card appears.

zh-TW.text: 關卡是合併卡出現前，PR 必須通過的一項自動檢查。

en.text: The six gates are branch, rebase, scope, fail-first, CI and approval.

zh-TW.text: 六關是分支、重定基底、範圍、先失敗測試、CI 和核准。

en.text: A carry keeps an approval for a new head when the patch stays the same.

zh-TW.text: 沿用核准是在補丁不變時，把核准留給新的 head。

en.text: A door says how easy a change is to undo: a two-way door is easy and a one-way door is hard.

zh-TW.text: 門的種類說明改動是否容易復原：雙向門容易復原，單向門難以復原。

en.text: SPEC-OK is the preflight answer that says a spec has no gaps.

zh-TW.text: SPEC-OK 是預檢的結論，表示規格沒有缺口。

en.text: A preflight is a review of a proposed spec before any worker starts.

zh-TW.text: 預檢是工人開始前對提議規格的審查。

en.text: A round is one worker run or one reviewer run on a task.

zh-TW.text: 輪次是工人或審查者在一個任務上的一次執行。

en.text: A brief is the note that firstmate writes to tell a worker what the next round needs.

zh-TW.text: 工作簡報是 firstmate 寫給工人的說明，指出下一次執行要做什麼。

en.text: The autopilot is the firstmate loop that moves a task from review to its merge card.

zh-TW.text: 自動駕駛是 firstmate 的迴圈，它把任務從審查推進到合併卡。

en.text: The board is the web page where the captain reads and answers cards.

zh-TW.text: 看板是船長閱讀並回答決策卡的網頁。

en.text: The scope is the list of file patterns that a task may change.

zh-TW.text: 範圍是任務可以修改的檔案模式清單。

en.text: A fail-first test fails on the old code and passes on the new code.

zh-TW.text: 先失敗測試在舊程式上失敗，在新程式上通過。
